Leah (eng-security): Heads up: pen-test intake created. Retest window Thu 09:00-15:00 UTC. Need quick confirmations by Tue EOD: 1) ephemeral RBAC for external assessors; 2) KMS access model for evidence objects; 3) audit export path + retention. Also: deployment freeze window and rollback/canary behavior. Goal = minimal blast radius + auditable handoff.

Tom (eng-sre): We can provision an ephemeral IAM role `pt-assessor-2026` that external assessors assume. Policy will be tightly scoped to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-2026-99/* with s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket. No Put/Delete. Max session 6h. Need assessor AWS account IDs (or OIDC sub).

Leah (eng-security): We have two assessor account IDs inbound from vendor. I'll DM them. For KMS: prefer CMK policy that only allows Decrypt when request includes tag `pt_assessor:true` and request comes from our role ARN. Is that doable?

Tom (eng-sre): Yes. Either CMK policy Condition on `aws:RequestTag/pt_assessor` or use a KMS Grant that we create and attach to the role. Grants are nice because they can be revoked. Example condition snippet I can add to the CMK: "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt_assessor": "true"}}

Ana (eng-ops): Logging/export: plan is CloudTrail + application JSON logs + ALB access logs -> s3://sec-evidence/pt-2026-99/raw/ then forward to our SIEM (Splunk) and Loki for short-term analysis. S3 lifecycle: 180d for hot copy, then move to Glacier Deep Archive for 2y. SIEM retention is 1y. Question: do we need PII redaction pre-export or can SIEM handle it?

Leah (eng-security): Redact PII before it goes to S3. Use our log-scrubber pipeline (schema-aware). Ana: can you do a small scrub run with synthetic data and post a presigned sample?

Ana (eng-ops): Will run scrub Tue 17:30 UTC. I'll put a sample at s3://sec-evidence/pt-2026-99/samples/redacted-sample.json and post a presigned link here.

Leon (eng-platform): Deployment freeze: recommend Thu 07:00-17:00 UTC (2 hr buffer). Canary: enable traffic-weighted canary on inference endpoints with auto-rollback if error rate > 0.8% sustained for 3 minutes or P50 latency increases by > 150ms. Also adding fallback to a lower-capacity model variant with a different routing tag.

Leah (eng-security): Rollback thresholds good. Please publish rollback runbook link once set. Also we need a calendar block and release freeze tag on the repo.

sec-bot: Pen-test ticket created: SEC-2026-99. Evidence bucket: `redwood-pt-2026-99`. Dry-run export scheduled Tue 17:30 UTC. Oncall: @Tom. Manifest path: `pt-2026-99/manifest.json`. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/security/tickets/SEC-2026-99

Tom (eng-sre): Presign plan: create a manifest with object metadata + presigned URLs for artifacts > 50MB. Presign TTL 86400s (24h) for this engagement by default. Command used in dry-run: `aws s3 presign s3://sec-evidence/pt-2026-99/trace.tgz --expires-in 86400`. If vendor needs longer, we'll use our presign service which enforces audit logging.

Ana (eng-ops): Scrub dry-run done. Sample uploaded, presigned link: (redacted) — posted in DM and I will paste index link here after sec review. Life cycle rule and CloudTrail filter set for prefix `pt-2026-99/*`.

Leah (eng-security): Owners: Tom = IAM role + presigned manifest + KMS grant/CMK change; Ana = redaction dry-run + lifecycle + SIEM hookup; Leon = freeze + canary + runbook; Leah = vendor liaison + evidence README. Can we do a readiness check Wed 19:00 UTC in #eng-security? :white_check_mark: 

Tom (eng-sre): Ack. I will post the role ARN + trust policy and the KMS grant ID Wed EOB. Enforcing sts:TagSession with `pt_assessor=true` on assume-role.

Ana (eng-ops): Ack. If log-scrubber rules need tweaks, may request extra 1-2 hours Wed morning.

Leon (eng-platform): Ack. Will add freeze to release calendar and attach runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pt-fallback-2026-99 (will post once live).

Leah (eng-security): Final checklist for Tue EOD before vendor handoff: - ephemeral role ARN + trust policy posted - KMS grant or policy update + grant ID - presigned manifest uploaded - redacted sample available - S3 lifecycle + CloudTrail export confirmed - release freeze visible + runbook link - evidence README with access steps

Leah (eng-security): Flag issues here. Otherwise readiness check Wed 19:00. Thanks all :pray:
